description: Gold Coast public Wi-Fi Locations is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Gold Coast. A layer showing the locations of the Public Wi-Fi coverage across the Gold Coast Local Government Area. Coverage: City of Gold Coast. The portal files it under the publisher City of Gold Coast. Its tags are City of Gold Coast, Hot Spot, Internaet Access, Internet, Network. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIPPED ESRI FILE GEODATABASE. The portal shows 2024-05-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
